description: Who has a version of a report open right now and where each of them is in it, as the people reading it see one another: for each open tab, the name, whether it is the person you work for (you), when it arrived and last moved, and what it shares in signals: cursor (where the pointer is: a block of the report, numbered from 0, and a point in it as fractions), selection (text selected: a block and character offsets), and part (the part of a design canvas they picked, selected while editing or chosen to comment on, named in words with its block and its id in the canvas, as `{ "block": 1, "element": "go-next", "label": "sticky \"Next step\"" }`); an interactive page may add its own (page, rooms). A tab that shares nothing has empty signals. Read it when someone says "this" or "the selected one" about a report, then read_report_data or the report itself for the part. The same person in two tabs is two entries. Leave version out for the newest version the person may read; people reading an older version are only in that version.

version.description: The version whose readers to list (list_report_versions gives numbers). Leave it out for the newest.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: read_report_presence
title: Who has a report open, and what they picked
